title: Cuartos
shortDescription: Plan rooms in 2D and 3D, explore colours and furniture, and work offline.
fullDescription:
Make room for your ideas before moving the furniture.

Cuartos lets you create rooms with real measurements, arrange them in a 2D plan and explore the result in a 3D view. Projects are saved on your device so you can work offline.

DESIGN YOUR SPACE
Create rectangular rooms, L-shaped rooms or two connected spaces. Enter measurements in metres or centimetres and add doors and windows with adjustable dimensions and positions.

EXPLORE FINISHES AND FURNITURE
Choose wall and floor colours, try finish samples and arrange a catalogue of 16 generic furniture items. Move, rotate, duplicate or delete pieces in the plan, then view the same design in 3D.

REVIEW EACH IDEA
Zoom and pan the plan, read dimensions and change the 3D camera. Use the top view or cutaway view to explore the layout. Undo and redo design changes during the current session.

SAVE AND SHARE
Create, rename, duplicate and delete local projects. Export a project as JSON to keep a copy or import it later. Save a PNG plan or share it using Android's options.

WORK AT YOUR OWN PACE
Spanish and English interface for phones and tablets. No registration, advertising, in-app purchases or remote services.

Cuartos is a tool for exploring layouts and decoration. Its representations and furniture are schematic; it does not replace construction drawings or professional technical advice.
releaseNotes: First Cuartos version: rectangular, L-shaped and connected rooms; 2D plans, 3D views, colours, 16 furniture items, offline projects and JSON/PNG files. Spanish and English interface.
